text:
Situation: Oxaliplatin supply is constrained at both Corvale sites. Corvale General holds 57 units with 20 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 8 units with 9 days on hand. The Baxter product we stock (NDC 43066-014-01) is manufactured at FAREVA Unterach GmbH for Sandoz Inc. and does not appear on the FDA shortage list.

Why (FDA record): The FDA shortage list shows discontinuations by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (NDC 63323-750-10) posted 2026-02-25 and Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (NDC 25021-233-10) posted 2026-06-29. No entry exists for the Baxter NDC we carry.

Our position: We have sufficient stock at Corvale General to support an internal transfer that would extend Corvale Lakeside coverage to approximately 15 days while maintaining two weeks at Corvale General. Alternative manufacturers are not on the FDA shortage list today, but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 6 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Accord Healthcare Inc. — requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate purchase from Apotex Corp. — requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from BluePoint Laboratories — requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications at this time.
